regions.today: Dry, warm and sunny this evening with a light to moderate northeasterly breeze.
regions.tonight: Mild and dry tonight with mostly clear skies. Lowest temperatures of 13 to 17 degrees in a light to moderate northeasterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will see a continuation of the warm spell of weather and it'll be a mainly dry and sunny day. Later in the day, however, there is a chance of a few heavy showers breaking out. Highest temperatures of 22 to 28 degrees, hottest in the midlands and south, and a little less warm in coastal parts of the east with light to moderate easterly winds.
